visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black long-sleeved button-down shirt, stands in front of a nighttime city skyline background featuring a prominent lit-up skyscraper (Taipei 101). He holds a small black object in his right hand and gestures with both hands as he speaks directly to the camera. (2) A screenshot of a scientific paper titled 'Lateralized sleeping positions in domestic cats' appears as a central overlay on the screen, while the man continues his narration in the background. (3) The man is shown again gesturing. A close-up image of a gray tabby cat sleeping on its side is superimposed on the frame. The man moves his hands in a circular motion. (4) A digital bar chart titled 'Leftward' and 'Rightward' appears as an overlay, showing numerical data regarding cat sleeping positions. Below the chart, images of a gray cat and an orange cat sleeping are displayed. (5) A line drawing illustration of a cat sleeping with annotated visual field lines appears, demonstrating how a cat's left eye and ear monitor surroundings while sleeping on its left side. (6) The man returns to the primary view, smiling and continuing his explanation with expressive hand movements and a confident posture until the video ends.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 你家的貓 (大概) 是左派. [Subtitle]: 科學家終於解開了. (2) [Subtitle]: 那個沒有人在乎的問. (3) [Subtitle]: 由義大利、德國等多國科學家. (4) [Subtitle]: 組成的團隊. (5) [Subtitle]: 這次不進實驗室. (6) [Subtitle]: 改當起雲端貓奴. (7) [Subtitle]: 狂刷了 408 部. (8) [Subtitle]: YouTube 上的貓貓睡覺影片. (9) [Subtitle]: 沒錯他們邊看貓貓睡覺. (10) [Subtitle]: 還發了一篇 paper. (11) [Subtitle]: 上頂尖期刊當代生物學. (12) [Subtitle]: 欸等等等看 FB 可以發現新水熊就算了. (13) [Subtitle]: 現在看 YT 影片也能發. (14) [Subtitle]: 研究到頂尖期刊. (15) [Subtitle]: 這不會有樣本偏差嗎. (16) [Subtitle]: 會不會是貓奴特別愛拍貓躺左邊. (17) [Subtitle]: 或是 YT 演算法特別愛推左派貓貓呢. (18) [Subtitle]: 欸這的確是問題. (19) [Subtitle]: 而且這些貓是公是母有沒有懷孕. (20) [Subtitle]: 科學家也承認他們通通不知道. (21) [Subtitle]: 看樣子吸得還真不少. (22) [Subtitle]: 不過他們有盡力排除人為干擾. (23) [Subtitle]: 像是濾掉被鏡像翻轉過的假影片. (24) [Subtitle]: 妙的是分析 408 部來自世界各地多片之後. (25) [Subtitle]: 他們發現了一個高達三分之二的明顯趨勢. (26) [Subtitle]: 很難只用巧合來解釋. (27) [Subtitle]: 所以呢這個研究拋磚引玉. (28) [Subtitle]: 為這個議題開了第一槍. (29) [Subtitle]: 嗯應該說開了第一個罐罐. (30) [Subtitle]: 接下來呢就等更嚴謹的實驗室研究來驗證. (31) [Subtitle]: 好那他們到底發現了什麼. (32) [Subtitle]: 就是這些貓竟然有高達百分之 65.1. (33) [Subtitle]: 也就是將近三分之二都是左派. (34) [Subtitle]: 睡覺呢都愛躺左邊. (35) [Subtitle]: 為什麼呢科學家認為這跟他們的大腦偏側化有關. (36) [Subtitle]: 也就是左右腦的分工不一樣. (37) [Subtitle]: 他們的解釋是對大多數動物來說. (38) [Subtitle]: 右半腦更擅長處理威脅、空間感跟協調快速的逃跑動作. (39) [Subtitle]: 而我們的感官跟左右腦是交叉對應的. (40) [Subtitle]: 所以當貓貓躺左邊睡. (41) [Subtitle]: 他的左邊視野跟左耳. (42) [Subtitle]: 一接收到風吹草動. (43) [Subtitle]: 訊號就會優先傳送到反應最快的右半腦處理. (44) [Subtitle]: 越能讓訊號先進入左側視野的貓. (45) [Subtitle]: 就越能搶得先機. (46) [Subtitle]: 所以不論是覺得貓欠揍還是欠貓揍. (47) [Subtitle]: 都歡迎從左邊來. (48) [Subtitle]: 你看貓連睡覺都在戰術性躺平. (49) [Subtitle]: 他不是睡死他是在準備隨時跳起來. (50) [Subtitle]: 賞你一巴掌. (51) [Subtitle]: 欸記得把這則新聞放給你家的貓看. (52) [Subtitle]: 如果他說你們人類有病嗎. (53) [Subtitle]: 請務必來上節目.
